metadata.name: hookwars_craft
metadata.description: Hookwars (units): materials, capped drops from verified activity, recipes, repairs and item wear (docs/spec/11-hook-economy.md section 5).

instructions.name: apply_config
docs: Anyone applies a pending config change once it is ready.

instructions.name: apply_material_cap
docs: Anyone applies a pending cap once ready.

instructions.name: craft
docs: Crafts: burns the inputs, pays the fee and asks the output program to make the item.
Remaining accounts: `(material, material_mint, crafter holding)` per input, then the output
program's `mint_crafted` accounts after its first (the craft signer).

instructions.name: create_material
docs: The admin creates a material and its mint (no hook, decimals 0, mint authority
`["craft-minter"]`). Nothing drops until a drop rule names it.

instructions.name: create_recipe
docs: The admin creates a recipe; it is usable after the delay.

instructions.name: drop
docs: Drops material for `measured` units of verified activity of `source` to `recipient`. Only a
registered caller's `["craft-caller"]` PDA signs. Never fails for a spent cap or a rule
not yet in effect (it drops nothing), so the caller's own path is never blocked.

accounts.name: caller
docs: A registered caller's `["craft-caller"]` PDA.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the recipient's holding when it does not exist yet.

instructions.name: init
docs: Creates the config; the program's upgrade authority signs. Season 0 starts now.

instructions.name: init_wear
docs: Opens an item's wear with `max_charges` (0 = never wears). Only a registered caller's
`["craft-caller"]` PDA signs (the items engine at item creation, integration request).

accounts.name: caller
docs: A registered caller's `["craft-caller"]` PDA.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: The admin proposes a new treasury, season pool, output program, callers and params; they
apply after `admin_timelock_secs`.

instructions.name: propose_material_cap
docs: The admin proposes a new season cap for a material; anyone applies it after the delay
(`apply_material_cap`).

instructions.name: repair
docs: Repairs an item the signer holds: burns the inputs, pays the fee, restores charges and
wakes a dormant item. Remaining accounts: `(material, material_mint, holder holding)` per
input.

instructions.name: set_drop_rule
docs: The admin sets a drop rule. A new rule drops nothing until the delay has passed; a change
to an existing rule applies after the delay (lazily, at the next `drop`).

instructions.name: set_recipe
docs: The admin proposes new terms for a recipe (including `active`); they apply after the delay.

instructions.name: wear
docs: Adds `runs` applied effects to an item's wear. Only a registered caller's PDA signs (the
items engine at settlement, integration request). Never fails because the item is worn:
at `max_charges` it turns dormant and `ItemWorn` is emitted once.

accounts.name: caller
docs: A registered caller's `["craft-caller"]` PDA.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: the signer is not this program's upgrade authority

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: only the craft admin may do this

errors.name: BadParams
errors.msg: a craft parameter is out of bounds

errors.name: NotReady
errors.msg: no change is pending, or it is not ready yet

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one expected

errors.name: NotCaller
errors.msg: the signer is not a registered caller's PDA

errors.name: BadName
errors.msg: a material name or symbol is too long or empty

errors.name: RecipeClosed
errors.msg: the recipe is closed or not yet in effect

errors.name: WrongRecipe
errors.msg: the recipe is not of this kind, or not for this item's template

errors.name: LevelTooLow
errors.msg: the crafter's level is too low for this recipe

errors.name: NotItemHolder
errors.msg: the signer does not hold the item

errors.name: NotAnItem
errors.msg: not an item of the armory

types.name: CraftConfig
docs: `CraftConfig` at `["craft-config"]`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives `RECIPE_PROTOCOL_BPS` of every recipe fee (11 section 2.4).

fields.name: season_pool
docs: Receives the rest of every recipe fee (the season prize pool, 05 section 14).

fields.name: output_program
docs: The program whose `mint_crafted` makes a crafted item (the armory; integration request).

fields.name: callers
docs: Programs whose `["craft-caller"]` PDA may call `drop`, `init_wear` and `wear` (R42).

fields.name: season_origin
docs: Start of season 0.

fields.name: protocol_fees_total
docs: Every lamport of recipe fees the protocol has received (11 section 2.4).

types.name: CraftParams
docs: The craft parameters (11 section 11; every one "to set").

fields.name: recipe_protocol_bps
docs: `RECIPE_PROTOCOL_BPS`: the protocol's share of a recipe fee; the rest goes to the season pool.

fields.name: max_inputs
docs: `RECIPE_MAX_INPUTS` (at most `INPUTS_CAP`).

fields.name: season_secs
docs: Length of an emission season (caps reset each season).

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS` (00): delay on every params, drop rule, cap and recipe change.

types.name: DropRule
docs: `DropRule` at `["drop", source]` (11 section 5.2). The amount dropped is
`measured * per_unit_num / per_unit_den`, capped by the material's season cap.

fields.name: effective_at
docs: The rule drops nothing before this time.

types.name: DropTerms
docs: The settable part of a drop rule.

types.name: ItemWorn
docs: Emitted once, when an item turns dormant (11 section 5.4).

types.name: Material
docs: `Material` at `["material", id]` (11 section 5.2). Its mint is `["material-mint", id]`, a plain
units mint with no hook whose mint authority is `["craft-minter"]`.

fields.name: pending_cap
docs: A cap change waiting for its delay (0 = none).

types.name: PendingCraft
docs: `PendingCraft` at `["craft-pending"]`: a config change waiting for its delay.

types.name: ProtocolFee
docs: Every protocol collection (11 section 2.4); `mint` is the default key for native lamports.

types.name: Recipe
docs: `Recipe` at `["recipe", id]`.

fields.name: effective_at
docs: Usable from this time (a new recipe waits for the timelock too).

types.name: RecipeInput
docs: One recipe input.

types.name: RecipeTerms
docs: The settable part of a recipe (11 section 5.3).

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: `RECIPE_FEE_LAMPORTS` of this recipe.

fields.name: template_id
docs: `Craft`: the template made. `Repair`: the template repaired.

fields.name: param_min
docs: `Craft`: parameter ranges the output program draws from (equal bounds fix a field).

fields.name: charges_restored
docs: `Repair`: charges restored.

fields.name: min_level
docs: The `Crafter` level required (0 = none).

types.name: Wear
docs: `Wear` at `["wear", item]` (11 section 5.4): the item's charges, kept here rather than in the
armory `Item` (the items engine reads it, integration request).

fields.name: max_charges
docs: 0 = never wears.
